key_insight: Alterbute is a diffusion-based image-editing method that can change an object's intrinsic attributes (color, texture, material, shape) while keeping its perceived identity and scene context intact. It achieves this by training with a relaxed objective that disentangles intrinsic attributes from identity and context, enabling meaningful edits without heavy supervision.
problem_solved: Existing image-editing approaches either use unsupervised priors that often alter object identity or rely on restrictive supervision that prevents natural intrinsic variations; Alterbute addresses the need for controlled, identity-preserving intrinsic attribute edits.
method: Diffusion-based editing pipeline that conditions generation on target intrinsic-attribute prompts and an object-centric mask or localization.
Relaxed training objective that encourages disentanglement of intrinsic attributes from identity and scene context, allowing the model to change attributes while preserving identity.
Identity- and scene-aware constraints (e.g., perceptual/identity-preservation losses and compositional guidance) to maintain object identity and coherent integration with the background during edits.
impact: Provides practitioners a practical way to perform fine-grained, identity-preserving attribute edits for applications like product visualization, content creation, and data augmentation, reducing reliance on dense supervision while producing controllable, realistic edits.
visual_elements: Before / after triplets showing edits of color, texture, material, and shape on the same object to illustrate identity preservation.
Pipeline diagram: input image + mask/attribute prompt → diffusion-based editor → edited image, highlighting the relaxed training loop and conditioning signals.
Overlayed identity-preservation heatmap or feature-similarity visualization to show which object features are retained after editing.
UI mockup with attribute sliders or discrete attribute tokens to demonstrate user control and edit specificity.
paper_title: Alterbute: Editing Intrinsic Attributes of Objects in Images
paper_authors: Tal Reiss, Daniel Winter, Matan Cohen, Alex Rav-Acha, Yael Pritch
